decisions.v1: Static typed recruiter-first portfolio with no CMS or recorded narration
decisions.architecture: React Router 7 Framework Mode with static prerendering
decisions.motion: Motion 13 with LazyMotion and original Darshify icons
decisions.informationArchitecture: Artist profile to proof tracks to conversion
decisions.performance: 1.0 MiB total, 700 KiB images, 150 KiB gzip JavaScript
decisions.release: Private preview followed by atomic production cutover

tasks.title: Establish reproducible quality gates and CI
acceptance: Node 24 and npm scripts are reproducible locally and in CI
CI runs quality, test, build, and browser jobs in dependency order
Baseline browser test covers Home, Artist, Search, and Library without console errors
tasks.smokeTest: npm run format && npm run check && npm run test:e2e

tasks.title: Create the evidence-first content model
acceptance: Typed portfolio data replaces simulated popularity and playback facts
Every quantitative claim contains source, period, and verification status
Validation reports no duplicate IDs, slugs, or unresolved references
Direct lookup is O(1) and normalized search is O(n)
tasks.smokeTest: npm test -- src/content src/data/library.test.ts && npm run lint && npm run type-check && npm run build

tasks.title: Migrate to React Router Framework Mode and prerender routes
acceptance: Primary and case-study routes render meaningful static HTML
Existing public URLs remain compatible
Unknown paths return a designed recoverable 404
Client navigation remains functional after prerender
tasks.smokeTest: npm run type-check && npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- e2e/baseline.spec.ts e2e/prerender.spec.ts

tasks.title: Implement the editorial design system and Motion policy
acceptance: Approved black, green, neutral, type, spacing, and focus tokens are implemented
Archivo and IBM Plex Mono replace the unproven display font
Motion 13 LazyMotion is the only JavaScript animation runtime
Reduced motion renders all content in its final state
tasks.smokeTest: npm test -- src/motion src/lib/useReducedMotion.test.ts && npm run lint && npm run type-check && npm run build

tasks.title: Build the semantic responsive shell and conversion primitives
acceptance: Skip link, named navigation landmarks, main landmark, and route focus work
CV, Email, and LinkedIn controls are semantic and never hidden on mobile
Desktop rail and mobile bottom navigation meet the locked layout contract
Global keyboard handlers no longer steal normal page interactions
tasks.smokeTest: npm test -- src/components/ContactActions.test.tsx && npm run test:e2e -- e2e/shell-accessibility.spec.ts && npm run build

tasks.title: Build artifact-led covers and the Proof Waveform
acceptance: Proof Waveform peaks map to labelled evidence and stable case-study links
Priority covers use real/redacted evidence or fact-led typography
Covers provide meaningful alt text, fixed aspect ratio, and responsive delivery
No generic AI art or full-card rainbow gradients remain
tasks.smokeTest: npm test -- src/components/ProofWaveform.test.tsx src/components/EvidenceCover.test.tsx && npm run lint && npm run type-check && npm run build

tasks.title: Replace simulated playback with the silent Career Mix
acceptance: Global Play opens a silent 60-second guided tour
Pause, previous, next, progress, evidence link, and close are keyboard operable
Legacy player UI and all visible ambient audio, seek, likes, queue, shuffle, repeat, and fake timing are removed; compile-only compatibility code is deleted in Task 3.2.1
Timed state updates remain isolated to the Career Mix provider
tasks.smokeTest: npm test -- src/career-mix && npm run lint && npm run type-check && npm run build

tasks.title: Rebuild Home as the recruiter briefing
acceptance: Name, target role, proposition, sourced proof, CV, Email, LinkedIn, and Career Mix are visible in the first viewport
Exactly three Recruiter Essentials lead deeper exploration
Generic greeting, fake quick picks, and simulated popularity rankings are removed
Home works at 390x844 and 1440x900 without hiding conversion
tasks.smokeTest: npm test -- src/components/RecruiterHero.test.tsx src/pages/Home.test.tsx && npm run test:e2e -- e2e/recruiter-home.spec.ts && npm run build

tasks.title: Rebuild Artist and release rows around sourced proof
acceptance: Artist hierarchy is proposition, conversion, selected impact, releases, About, and contact
Every proof row exposes outcome, source/status, and a stable case-study action
Verified Candidate, monthly listeners, Follow, plays, and duration semantics are absent
Legacy playlist and liked URLs render truthful professional collections
tasks.smokeTest: npm test -- src/pages/ArtistPage.test.tsx src/components/ProofTrackRow.test.tsx src/components/ReleaseCard.test.tsx && npm run lint && npm run type-check && npm run build

tasks.title: Build complete, shareable case-study pages
acceptance: Every case study presents Situation, Action, Result, Evidence, source/status, and contact actions
All case-study slugs are prerendered with unique metadata
Real/redacted artifacts are placed beside the claims they support
Missing slugs produce a recoverable 404
tasks.timeComplexity: O(1) slug lookup; O(n) related-item rendering
tasks.smokeTest: npm test -- src/pages/CaseStudyPage.test.tsx && npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- e2e/case-studies.spec.ts e2e/prerender.spec.ts

tasks.title: Rebuild Search and Library as professional discovery tools
acceptance: Search is labelled, mobile-safe, deterministic, and links to stable routes
Search matches organization, skill, action, result, and recruiter takeaway
Library uses Career Library, releases, and professional category language
No raw search terms are persisted and interaction work stays below 50ms
tasks.timeComplexity: O(n) search/filter; O(n log n) explicit A-Z sort
tasks.smokeTest: npm test -- src/pages/Search.test.tsx src/pages/Library.test.tsx src/content/selectors.test.ts && npm run test:e2e -- e2e/discovery.spec.ts && npm run build

tasks.title: Add route metadata, structured data, and privacy-safe analytics
acceptance: Every prerendered route has unique title, description, canonical URL, and social metadata
Person and CreativeWork JSON-LD contain only supported claims
Analytics records only approved recruiter outcome events
No contact values, raw searches, or personal profiles enter analytics
tasks.smokeTest: npm test -- src/seo src/analytics src/components/ContactActions.test.tsx && npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- e2e/prerender.spec.ts

tasks.title: Enforce accessibility, responsive, coverage, link, and performance budgets
acceptance: New and modified runtime code meets 90% statements, branches, functions, and lines
Axe reports zero serious or critical violations on all key states
Initial transfer stays within 1.0 MiB total, 700 KiB images, and 150 KiB gzip JavaScript
Lighthouse mobile scores are at least 95 in all four required categories
Recruiter, Career Mix, route, contact, responsive, link, and 404 browser flows pass
tasks.timeComplexity: O(r + a) route and asset validation
tasks.smokeTest: npm run check && npm run test:e2e && npx lhci autorun

tasks.title: Validate the private preview and prepare atomic cutover
acceptance: Preview passes all automated gates against its immutable URL
Manual WCAG 2.2 AA, truth, link, source, and responsive audits are signed
At least 80% of five target-role reviewers pass both comprehension tasks
Production rollback deployment is recorded before cutover
Production changes only after explicit approval and post-cutover smoke passes
tasks.timeComplexity: O(r + c) route and claim audit
tasks.smokeTest: PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL=$PREVIEW_URL npm run test:e2e && LHCI_BUILD_CONTEXT__CURRENT_HASH=$(git rev-parse HEAD) npx lhci autorun
